title: Mystical Peru
short_description: Cusco - Coricancha - Sacsayhuamán - Pisac - Urubamba - Ollantaytambo - Chinchero - Machu Picchu - Rainbow Mountain
long_description: Welcome to Peru! Your adventure begins in Lima, where our team will greet you and accompany you through this unforgettable journey along the coast, the Andes, and the Inca world.
price_note: Includes transportation, entrance tickets, and professional guide.
seo_title: Mystical Peru 12D/11N - Lima, Cusco, Machu Picchu & Lake Titicaca | GT Peru Travel
seo_description: Mystical Peru Tour 12 days: Lima, Paracas, Ica, Cusco, Sacred Valley, Machu Picchu, Rainbow Mountain, Ruta del Sol and Lake Titicaca. The most complete Peru itinerary with GT Peru Travel.
seo_keywords: mystical peru, peru tour package, cusco machu picchu tour, sacred valley tour, lake titicaca tour, ruta del sol peru, humantay lake, rainbow mountain, gt peru travel

days.title: Day 1
days.text: Arrival in Lima and transfer to the hotel. Free time to rest. If your flight arrives early, you may take an optional city tour. Overnight in Lima.

days.title: Day 2
days.text: Full Day Paracas + Ica: Ballestas Islands tour, wildlife observation, vineyard visit with wine and pisco tasting, and adventure in Huacachina with buggies and sandboarding. Evening return to Lima.

days.title: Day 3
days.text: Flight Lima - Cusco. Airport pickup and transfer to the hotel. Free afternoon for acclimatization. Recommended: visit the Qosqo Native Art Center.

days.title: Day 4
days.text: Cusco City Tour + Morada de los Dioses: Visit Coricancha, Sacsayhuamán, Qenqo, Puca Pucara, and Tambomachay. Finish at the Morada de los Dioses, an artistic space inspired by Andean cosmology.

days.title: Day 5
days.text: Moray + Maras Salt Mines + Chinchero: Explore Moray’s circular agricultural terraces, the Maras salt mines, and the traditional textile centers of Chinchero. Return to Cusco.

days.title: Day 6
days.text: Sacred Valley Tour: Optional stop at Cochahuasi sanctuary, Taray viewpoint, Pisac ruins and silver workshops, buffet lunch in Urubamba, and final visit to Ollantaytambo. Overnight in Ollantaytambo.

days.title: Day 7
days.text: Machu Picchu - The Big Day: Early train to Aguas Calientes and bus up to Machu Picchu. Guided tour and free time. Return to Cusco by train and private transport.

days.title: Day 8
days.text: Humantay Lake: Trip to Soraypampa and hike to the turquoise Humantay Lake. Free time for photos. Buffet lunch in Mollepata and return to Cusco.

days.title: Day 9
days.text: Rainbow Mountain: Breakfast in Cusipata and hike to Vinicunca with views of Ausangate glacier, Andean fauna, and colorful landscapes. Buffet lunch and return to Cusco.

days.title: Day 10
days.text: Ruta del Sol (Cusco - Puno): Visits to Andahuaylillas, Raqchi, buffet lunch in Sicuani, La Raya viewpoint, and Pukara Museum. Arrival in Puno.

days.title: Day 11
days.text: Uros Islands + Sillustani: Boat trip to the floating Uros Islands, return to Puno and lunch. Afternoon visit to Sillustani tomb towers by Lake Umayo.

days.title: Day 12
days.text: Transfer to the airport according to your flight schedule. End of services.
